universal_guidelines: NEVER use pure white backgrounds. Always use #050505 or #09090b.
Borders are key. Use thin 1px borders with low opacity (border-white/10) to define structure.
Use Neon Cyan (#00f0ff) sparingly for focus states, active items, and primary actions.
Text hierarchy: Use 'Unbounded' for headers to give that futuristic tech feel.
Data Visualization: Charts must use dark backgrounds with neon stroke lines.
Don't clutter. Cyberpunk is about 'High Tech, Low Life' - make the tech feel sophisticated and clean.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Tailwind Colors: Update tailwind.config.js to include the custom neon palette.
2. Fonts: Add the Google Fonts import to index.css immediately.
3. Layout: Create a Layout component that includes the sidebar (desktop) and bottom nav (mobile).
4. Dashboard: Build the main dashboard using a Bento Grid layout (Grid Mode B).
5. Supabase: Ensure Supabase client is initialized but MOCK data if connection fails so the UI is reviewable.
6. Use the provided image URLs for the Inventory and Customer demo data.
